debate.why: A team of liberals and a team of conservatives take turns at a podium, arguing opposite sides of each prompt face to face and fact checking each other.

exchanges.motion: Do we need more laws to keep guns away from criminals?
exchanges.a_side: Gun laws for criminals already exist; enforce them
exchanges.b_side: Pass more laws to stop criminals getting guns
exchanges.hook_topic: on laws keeping guns from criminals
exchanges.retention: The clip opens on "Criminals should not have guns", and both sides agree on that, so it isn't clear yet where they actually split. The conservative says it's already a felony for a criminal to have a gun, and the liberal hits back that illegal voting is a felony too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Criminals should not have guns. Law-abiding Americans should.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Agreed. That's my decision. So, why don't we pass laws to make sure that criminals are not getting guns. Why don't we make it harder?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: We actually have a lot of those laws. It's currently a felony for a criminal to possess a gun.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And it's a felony to illegally vote.
